contract.server_read_projection: P4.6 derives bounded client summaries only from a validated P4.5 ownership state; canonical ecology remains server-owned
contract.summary_identity: summary_hash binds region, owner/epoch source cursor, source snapshot/ownership hashes, ecology generation/time cursor, backlog state and canonical lineage biomass summary
contract.lineage_projection: P3.7 community biomass is aggregated by lineage id, sorted canonically and reduced to total/dominant lineage without exposing mutable canonical state
contract.interest: requested region ids are canonicalized as sorted unique ids; duplicate authoritative states fail closed; missing requested regions remain explicit
contract.read_cache: client read updates are monotonic by ownership epoch, ecology generation and observed horizon; stale epochs/generations/times and equal-cursor conflicts fail closed
contract.mutation_isolation: all returned summaries/projections are detached values and there is no API that commits client data back to P4.5 ownership
contract.identity_scope: network transport timing, client frame rate, process identity and packet order are excluded from canonical read hashes

targeted_exact_attached_godot_evidence.parent_boundary: exact P4.5 kernel with minimal deterministic P4.4 validator boundary

committed_gate.runner_policy: run direct committed P4.5 acceptance test once, then P4.6 unit A/B under bounded 300-second process timeouts
committed_gate.integration_requirement: before P4.6 lifecycle acceptance, execute one additional committed real-P4.5 ownership-to-read-model integration probe and freeze its hashes
